name: CKEditor 5 Pre
description: Adds a <pre> (preformatted) option to the CKEditor 5 headings dropdown.
project_description: CKEditor 5 Pre extends the core CKEditor 5 editor by adding a <pre> (preformatted text) option to the block-format / Headings dropdown. It ships no PHP, no JavaScript and no routes: it is a declarative CKEditor 5 plugin definition (ckeditor5_pre.ckeditor5.yml) that reuses core's built-in ckeditor5_heading plugin to register an extra heading option with model 'pre', view element 'pre' and the editor-only label class ck-heading_pre, plus a small admin CSS file that renders the toolbar label in a monospace font. Editors can then mark a block as preformatted directly from the format menu. Because the plugin declares the <pre> element, Drupal auto-adds <pre> to the text format's Allowed HTML tags when the format is (re-)saved. It works reliably for plain text and single-level tags inside the block; wrapping multiple nested block-level elements may produce unexpected results.
